scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:cockpit
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run --root backend --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:watch: npm run build && vitest --root backend --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:apps-script
